title: Output of Hiring Signals by Company Domain
description: One row per domain in the default dataset (domains with no board, unsupported ATS or errors are included as free rows with status and error); a run summary in the OUTPUT record.

results.title: Hiring signals
results.description: One row per domain. Example: {"domain":"stripe.com","status":"ok","isHiring":true,"openJobs":412,"topFunction":"engineering","signals":["scaling_sales","hiring_leadership"]}. Not found: {"domain":"acme.com","status":"no_public_board_found","error":"..."}.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: domainsRequested, boardsFound, hiring, byStatus, bySignal, chargeLimitReached, zeroResultsReason, nextSteps.
